description: Keyring chain and checks (crypto.md 6, 9). Each case opens `open` as device `as`, after trusting `trustedChain` in order (the first entry on first use). `expect` is `ok` or a KeyringError code. Keyring files are hex, encrypted by rage, and signed by the reference sshsig. The recovery key is set from version 2 on; its signing seed is HKDF(secret, '', 'syncryption/v1/recovery-signing').
